report:
# FQ-PHASE-FIBER-QUOTIENT

The source zero relation is definitionally equality of phaseBlind functions. Global i and a relative sign lie in its fibers. The four Gaussian units form a declared finite subgroup, not a complete enumeration of every norm fiber. Norm25 has twelve Gaussian integer points but the orbit of5 has four; (3,4) is a concrete same-weight point outside that orbit. Enumeration includes zero and explicitly bounded integer coordinates.

Source phase-equivalence and relative/global-phase kernel statements are rechecked; the full single-coordinate norm25 integer fiber has twelve points while the declared unit orbit has four.

Remaining: Relate multi-report unit-group orbits to the intended quotient without identifying an orbit with the full norm fiber. A general finite-group action/quotient operad and coherence proof remain open.
